programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Jaane Jigar
programme.desc: Two women look identical but hail from different backgrounds. They fall in love with Ravi and Vijay who are best friends. Misunderstandings arise when they believe they are in love with the same girl.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

Items that attract the attention of the team include glass sailing boats, a Rolex watch, a Chinese snuff bottle and a selection of Corgi toy cars.

programme.desc: S6 E3 — Nerds of the Round TableIvy tries to keep his winning streak going, while Darrell and Rene play mind games with each other. Jarrod and Brandi visit a crime scene and travel back in time.

programme.desc: S6 E4 — Operation: IntimidationBrandi is intent on closing the Long Beach store, but Jarrod is determined to save it by scoring more lockers. Ivy tries to intimidate other buyers, while Darrell gets the shock treatment.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time for the chefs from the South West and only two remain. Who will cook their entire menus for the `Great British Menu' judges, Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton and their guest, writer and performer Simon Day? The judges aren't easily pleased and only world-class cooking will do.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Welsh chefs raise the curtain with their starters, but which one is going to produce a showstopper? All three contestants have created sophisticated plates of food with simple dish titles. Will veteran Jeremy Lee be impressed with Richard Davies's chicken salad or will Mary Ann Gilchrist's peas and ham or Luke Thomas's ham, egg and pineapple get them off to a flying start?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Welsh chefs cook their fish course. Richard Davies serves up grilled and tartare of mackerel, while Mary Ann Gilchrist serves a lobster dish and calls it `The Great Escape'. Luke Thomas is hoping that his quirky take on a classic fish finger will impress veteran Jeremy Lee too.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Welsh chefs prepare their main courses, but will any of them impress veteran Jeremy Lee enough to give them a top score? Richard Davies's dish is simply called `A Tasting of Pork', Mary Ann Gilchrist's `Three's a Crowd' doesn't give much away, while Luke Thomas's dish is called `Beef, Bone Marrow and Watercress'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the final chance for the Welsh chefs to impress Jeremy Lee with their dessert dishes. Which creation will help get two chefs through to the judging show? Will it be Richard Davies's strawberries and cream with a Comic Relief twist, or will Mary Ann Gilchrist's `Some Like It Hot' or Luke Thomas's rhubarb and custard get them through?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Great British Menu continues as 24 of the nation's finest chefs battle it out to cook gastronomic masterpieces that are also witty and fun. Their dishes have to put a smile on faces as they compete for the prize of cooking a dish at a special banquet at the Royal Albert Hall celebrating 25 years of Comic Relief's Red Nose Day appeals. It is decision time for the chefs representing Wales.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three North East chefs all want to top the leader board on day one with their starter. How will Colin McGurran's tomato gazpacho and garden salad perform? Stephanie Moon thinks she also has a chance with a witty chicken dish called `Why Did the Chicken...', and Charlie Lakin offers a controversial duck dish called `Mind Your Step'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The North East chefs cook their fish courses. Will former champion Colin McGurran's dish of cockles and mussels with salmon, inspired by his childhood memories, also inspire veteran judge Jason Atherton? Or perhaps Stephanie Moon's fish dish with a nod to one of the most famous gags of all time, crab custard pie, will be the winner? Charlie Lakin is also confident with his creation called `Tongue in Cheek'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The North East chefs cook their main course and veteran Jason Atherton is looking for perfection. Will Colin McGurran's dish of duck and turnips be funnier than it sounds? Has Stephanie Moon dropped the comedy ball with her venison dish called `Behind the Fun is Some Serious Game'? Will Charlie Lakin's kebab inspired dish `A Night on the Tiles' raise a smile?

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E38 — Netherlands v MoroccoNetherlands v Morocco (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. The European side made it through to this stage after they finished top of Group F thanks to winning two and drawing one of their three matches. 5-1 and 3-1 victories over Sweden and Tunisia put them through after they drew 2-2 with Japan in their opening match of the tournament. Morocco finished second in Group C behind five-time winners Brazil on goal difference, and beat Haiti 4-2 in their final game to end their group campaign on seven points and progress to the knockout stages for the second successive time. These two sides have met just the once in a competitive match when they faced each other in a group match at the 1994 World Cup. Netherlands won that game 2-1 thanks to goals from Dennis Bergkamp and Bryan Roy.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E3Kelvin takes his son Milo on an adventure to his first cattle market, while the pigs run amok as they are being moved into the woodland. Liz channels her inner shepherdess as she single-handedly delivers a lamb, while the twins celebrate their first birthday, but an escapee sheep means dinner is on hold.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E41Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Ivory Coast v NorwayIvory Coast v Norway (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Ivory Coast finished second in Group E on six points, just losing out on top spot due to their head-to-head record against group winners Germany. Despite that they still created history after they reached the knockout stages for the first time, after three previous attempts. Stale Solbakken chose to rest the vast majority of his Norwegian first choice players for their group decider against France, which the subsequently lost 4-1, meaning they will at least be refreshed as they aim to reach the last 16.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: France v SwedenFrance v Sweden (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. France are the tournament favourites, after an impressive group campaign that saw them win all three matches and score goals for fun, including a 4-1 win against a weakened Norway in their last match. Sweden have produced a mixed bag of results to progress in third place from their group, thrashing Tunisia, being hammered by the Netherlands, and then drawing 1-1 to Japan, in a result that saw both teams qualify.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Mexico v EcuadorMexico v Ecuador (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Mexico City Stadium. Mexico were one of only three nations to win all three of their group fixtures, giving them home advantage at a ground on which they have an outstanding record. Ecuador progressed as one of the third-placed qualifiers, largely thanks to their 2-1 win over Germany, which they did the hard way, coming from a goal down to finish on four points behind the Germans and Ivory Coast.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Banker's Best Battles

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E38 — Netherlands v MoroccoNetherlands v Morocco (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. The European side made it through to this stage after they finished top of Group F thanks to winning two and drawing one of their three matches. 5-1 and 3-1 victories over Sweden and Tunisia put them through after they drew 2-2 with Japan in their opening match of the tournament. Morocco finished second in Group C behind five-time winners Brazil on goal difference, and beat Haiti 4-2 in their final game to end their group campaign on seven points and progress to the knockout stages for the second successive time. Netherlands won that game 2-1 thanks to goals from Dennis Bergkamp and Bryan Roy.

programme.desc: Ivory Coast v NorwayIvory Coast v Norway (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E38 — Netherlands v MoroccoNetherlands v Morocco (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. The European side made it through to this stage after they finished top of Group F thanks to winning two and drawing one of their three matches. 5-1 and 3-1 victories over Sweden and Tunisia put them through after they drew 2-2 with Japan in their opening match of the tournament. Morocco finished second in Group C behind five-time winners Brazil on goal difference, and beat Haiti 4-2 in their final game to end their group campaign on seven points and progress to the knockout stages for the second successive time. These two sides have met just the once in a competitive match when they faced each other in a group match at the 1994 World Cup. Netherlands won that game 2-1 thanks to goals from Dennis Bergkamp and Bryan Roy.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E38 — Netherlands v MoroccoNetherlands v Morocco (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. The European side made it through to this stage after they finished top of Group F thanks to winning two and drawing one of their three matches. 5-1 and 3-1 victories over Sweden and Tunisia put them through after they drew 2-2 with Japan in their opening match of the tournament. Netherlands won that game 2-1 thanks to goals from Dennis Bergkamp and Bryan Roy.

The European side made it through to this stage after they finished top of Group F thanks to winning two and drawing one of their three matches. 5-1 and 3-1 victories over Sweden and Tunisia put them through after they drew 2-2 with Japan in their opening match of the tournament. Morocco finished second in Group C behind five-time winners Brazil on goal difference, and beat Haiti 4-2 in their final game to end their group campaign on seven points and progress to the knockout stages for the second successive time. These two sides have met just the once in a competitive match when they faced each other in a group match at the 1994 World Cup. Netherlands won that game 2-1 thanks to goals from Dennis Bergkamp and Bryan Roy.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E3Kelvin takes his son Milo on an adventure to his first cattle market, while the pigs run amok as they are being moved into the woodland. Liz channels her inner shepherdess as she single-handedly delivers a lamb, while the twins celebrate their first birthday, but an escapee sheep means dinner is on hold.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Ivory Coast v NorwayIvory Coast v Norway (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Ivory Coast finished second in Group E on six points, just losing out on top spot due to their head-to-head record against group winners Germany. Despite that they still created history after they reached the knockout stages for the first time, after three previous attempts. Stale Solbakken chose to rest the vast majority of his Norwegian first choice players for their group decider against France, which the subsequently lost 4-1, meaning they will at least be refreshed as they aim to reach the last 16.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: France v SwedenFrance v Sweden (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. programme.desc: S5 E38 — Netherlands v MoroccoNetherlands v Morocco (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. The European side made it through to this stage after they finished top of Group F thanks to winning two and drawing one of their three matches. 5-1 and 3-1 victories over Sweden and Tunisia put them through after they drew 2-2 with Japan in their opening match of the tournament. Morocco finished second in Group C behind five-time winners Brazil on goal difference, and beat Haiti 4-2 in their final game to end their group campaign on seven points and progress to the knockout stages for the second successive time. These two sides have met just the once in a competitive match when they faced each other in a group match at the 1994 World Cup. Netherlands won that game 2-1 thanks to goals from Dennis Bergkamp and Bryan Roy.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8Ships don't have to be large to change the course of history. The Smithsonian has a small 1776 wooden gunboat, built to stop a British invasion and two Japanese midget submarines were part of the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E1Albert Speer was Hitler’s favorite architect and a central figure within the Führer’s inner circle. Speer’s buildings helped cement Hitler’s position and push Germany towards war.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E2Wernher von Braun was instrumental to NASA’s Apollo 11 mission that put a man on the moon. His pioneering work in rocketry made it possible, but his past was kept under wraps.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E5A Greenpeace ship is bombed in 1985, killing Fernando Pereira. The French authorities deny responsibility and questions over nuclear restrictions arise again.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E6In 1979, Maurice Bishop takes control of Grenada. Four years later, he is assassinated. Is this another case of the US using its might to stop Communism?

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7A look at the military engineering used as US and South Vietnamese forces attempt to overcome North Vietnam and the Viet Cong.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8A look at the origins of the Arms Race between the USA and the Soviet Union, and the nuclear weapons that ended WWII.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E3Werner Heisenberg is one of the most controversial scientists of the Third Reich. A key figure in the Nazis’ efforts to build an atomic bomb, the target of an Allied assassination plot.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E4Hans Kammler’s fingerprints can be found all over the Third Reich’s most prestigious and deadly engineering projects—not as an architect or inventor, but as a project manager.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E5The Soviet Union produced a large variety of tanks and airplanes during World War II. What made the T34 and the Chaika stand out and become icons?

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E6Two of the fastest combat aircraft of World War 2, their origins couldn't differ more. The Messerschmitt 262 was the brainchild of genius designer Willy Messerschmitt and it became the first combat jet in history.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E1A look at the women surrounding Hitler once he came to power, and how they were held up as the Aryan Ideal to strive for once the Nazi dictator approved of their positions.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E2How women were active - and often violent participants and perpetrators - in the conflict and its attendant atrocities - especially the Holocaust.
